correctness.rationale: For every team and omitted valuation, projection closure is equivalent to hitting every difference support. At at most r rows one coordinate per row excludes the tuple; at r+1 rows the support family has transversal number r+1 exactly when its nonempty supports are disjoint. A partition bijection proves the Stirling formula and a coordinate-by-coordinate contradiction gives uniqueness for r>=2. Direct finite checker tested 42980 omitted valuations against actual projection semantics.

value.rationale: A motivated arity bottleneck for an established inclusion-atom logic has a sharp complete first-obstruction classification and closed all-parameter Stirling census, as well as a canonical semantic kernel.
